subject: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: datadog-sales@datadog.com, sales@grafana.com, sentry-ps@getsentry.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Team — kicking off a short sourcing sprint to collect bids and evidence for our log/metrics retention add-ons. Procurement needs a consolidated package by EOW Nov 30 to inform the December renewals cadence.

Quick background:
- We will be evaluating add-on pricing and technical evidence for long-term log retention (90/365/540 days), egress/restore SLA, and cold storage export support.
- Vendors in scope: Datadog, Grafana Cloud (Loki/Cloud), and Sentry (for error/trace archival).

Asks (owners):
1) Vivek — vendor cost impact model: run 3 scenarios (90/365/540) and fill the attached pricing matrix. Include tokenized estimate for peak ingestion spikes. (Due Nov 24)
2) Neha — security/compliance evidence: request SOC2 reports, retention export playbook, and KMS/HSM details from each vendor; collect in Drive. (Due Nov 26)
3) Camila — procurement contacts and commercial levers: capture any programmatic credits, multi-year bundling options, and standard redline points. Start with the listed contacts and push DocuSign links. (Due Nov 27)

I've attached the retention requirements doc and a blank pricing matrix. I looped vendor contacts; feel free to reply-all to create canonical threads per vendor. If anyone needs an exception to the timeline, flag now.

Thanks — Olg
Olga Petrov
Head of Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference

From: datadog-sales@datadog.com
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Hi Olga / team — thanks for the note. Attached our standard add-on term sheet and a short FAQ on archive/restore SLAs. High-level: we can offer a blended discount if you commit to a 12-month retention add-on at scale; pricing depends on compressed storage tiers and egress patterns.

Action items for you: please share estimated average daily ingested bytes (or the scenario numbers Vivek will send) so we can produce a comparable bid. Also happy to schedule a 30-min technical call with our product engineer this week.

Attachment stubs: datadog-retention-term-sheet.pdf, datadog-archive-faq.pdf

— Datadog Sales

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: datadog-sales@datadog.com, sales@grafana.com, sentry-ps@getsentry.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Folks — attaching the filled pricing matrix (scenario rows populated) plus current ingestion profile summarized per product line. Notes:
- Peak ingestion spikes are driven by nightly batch jobs (approx 45% uplift for 2–3 hours).
- Datadog: compression assumptions matter — their term sheet does not call out compressed vs logical TB.
- Grafana Cloud: ask for cold tier pricing and restore window SLAs (Grafana rep, please add).
- Sentry: we care about error-trace retention costs for high-volume projects; any aggregation/rollup options would reduce spend.

I've left placeholder cells for vendor responses and legal exceptions.

Attachment: 2026-11-24_pricing_matrix.xlsx

— Vivek

From: sales@grafana.com
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Hi Camila / Olga — thanks for the matrix. We can provide the cold storage pricing by compressed TB and a standard 72-hour restore SLA for cold-tier objects. We also have a migration credit for customers taking a 36-month commitment that we can apply to the first-year bill.

Two quick clarifications needed from your team:
- Do you require customer-managed encryption keys for cold-tier exports?
- Will you want on-demand restores programmatically or via support requests?

Attachment stubs: grafana-cloud-cold-tier.pdf

— Grafana Sales

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: sales@grafana.com, datadog-sales@datadog.com, sentry-ps@getsentry.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T14:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention add-ons sourcing sprint for observability vendors (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Thanks — few evidence asks (recording here so all vendors see same list):
1) Current SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months) and any ISO proofs.
2) Retention export playbook (how to export >365 days of logs reliably) and time-to-restore test results for >3TB restores.
3) KMS/HSM integration guide and whether BYOK is supported for archived objects.
4) Audit log examples showing export/restoration events and requester identity.

Please send items as PDFs and indicate where we can verify hashes on Drive. We need these by Nov 30 for the compliance review.

Attachment: 2026-11-26_procurement-checklist.docx

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:42:00Z
Subject: Consolidated notes + next steps (procurement packet due today)

Team — status update and gating items before I upload the packet to Procurement Hub (final deadline EOD today):
- Datadog: submitted term sheet and archive FAQ; waiting on their SOC2 redaction; commercial contact confirmed 7% multi-year migration credit (pending legal).
- Grafana: provided cold-tier pricing and 72-hour restore SLA; flagged migration credit and asked about BYOK.
- Sentry: (reply thread separate) pricing for error archival likely lower but needs project-level rollup options; they asked for projected event volume by project.
- Outstanding: vendors need to upload SOC2 + export playbooks to the Drive link; I will chase non-responders at 17:00 PT.

Next steps (owners):
- Olga: sign off on the shortlist (Datadog vs Grafana cold-tier + Sentry for traces) so I can finalize procurement doc.
- Vivek: add final numbers we received in the matrix and mark the recommended option.
- Neha: if SOC2 files are not in Drive by 17:00 PT, mark vendor non-compliant for our renewal decision.

I'll push the packet to HubSpot record OBSV-4321 and add a procurement summary.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Vendor Programs, Redwood Inference
